Name: Bog's Flyquest Fan Furniture
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
An Alternative Textures mod for people who love Flyquest the esports org!

Download Alternative Textures, buy the paint bucket from Robin
make sure you have the correct furniture pieces, click on them and set the new texture!

Calendar: Flyquest Logo Painting
China Cabinet: Flyquest gaming setup
House Plant: Green Gamer Chair (just decoration)
Light Green Run: Flyquest Rug
Bed: Flyquest Bed

shouout to Robokit12 for opening permissions for thier [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16419]Gaming Room Custom Furniture
[/url]i grabbed and retextured/recolored the PC monitor keyboard and mouse﻿ from this<3

My new BogWyytch Character artwork done by: [url=https://x.com/sadlittleacorn]SadLittleAcorn[/url]
you should totally commission her! She is wonderful and amazing!!!

My custom in game character was done by: [url=https://x.com/mushlune]Mushlune
[/url]She takes commissions as well so if you want a custom farmer totally hit her up!﻿

Check out [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods]my other mods[/url] as i have been working hard to turn the entire game into my aesthetic!!!

If you would like to see updates on my mods or get notified when a mod is published , follow my [url=https://x.com/ellektrikk]twitter![/url] and put on notifications (i promise i wont spam you hehehe)

Again thank you so much for everything. I have been blown away by all your support.
